title: SmartBreeze AI Quantum Edition
body:
WiFi-enabled. App-controlled. Learns your preferences. Connects to your smart home. It's just a fan but SMART.

Features:
- WiFi + Bluetooth
- Voice control (Alexa/Google)
- Temperature sensor
- Auto-adjust mode
- Energy monitoring
- OTA updates
summary: WiFi-enabled. App-controlled. Learns your preferences. It's just a fan but SMART.
